description: Score-honest C++17 prototype of a fully deterministic integer-only streaming context model: byte-canonical arithmetic coding, decoder-recomputable lexer and grammar sidecar contexts, tiny fixed-point SSM, local nonstationary state tables, and adaptive integer log-odds mixer.
notes: Corrects the blueprint alignment issue by never emitting grammar symbols as the coded stream. The coded stream remains raw bytes; grammar and lexer are sidecar contexts updated from completed decoded history.
No trained tensor payload is included. The fixed-point SSM uses deterministic LCG weights, so this tests synchronization and local adaptive modeling, not a trained neural predictor.
verdict: Reject as a standalone compressor. The corrected deterministic pipeline is synchronized and score-honest, but the untrained integer model is far behind LZMA and recovered fx2 on the same prefix.
